description: Send an SMS text message from your TextForAgents number.

from_number.description: Your TextForAgents number to send from; defaults to your account's assigned number.

idempotency_key.description: Optional caller-chosen idempotency key: retrying the send with the same key returns the original message instead of sending (and charging) again. A fresh key is generated when omitted.

media_urls.description: Approved MMS attachments as public HTTPS URLs.

optimize.description: Opt in to normalization of outgoing text before metering.

to.description: Destination phone number in E.164 format, e.g. +18185550199.

name: send_sms
